enunciado: In a maze modelled as a graph (edges 0-1, 1-2, 2-6, 0-3, 3-4, 4-5, 5-6) use BFS storing each vertex's parent to rebuild and print the shortest path from 0 to 6 and from 0 to 5.
objetivos: Rebuild paths recursively from the target
pistas: parentOf[v] = u when you discover v from u.
The path comes out backwards: from target to source.
Print recursively: first the path to the parent, then the vertex.
